notes.list_status: unofficial; nominations close 2026-08-21 14:00. Names are published 'as it is to appear on the ballot'.
notes.source_note: The tables are headed 'Name (as it is to appear on the ballot)', so the names are recorded in ballot form, nicknames included.
notes.name_format_note: Surnames are printed in CAPS and given names in mixed case, so the surname boundary is unambiguous even for multi-word surnames such as 'Lilian LUM MBAH'. Splitting uses the capitalisation, not token position.
notes.structure_match: A single at-large 'Candidates for City Councillor' list with no ward breakdown, matching the structure CSV's at-large row (8 seats, vote-for-8). No elected Regional Councillor race appears, consistent with SOURCES.md noting Niagara abolished elected regional councillors for 2026.
notes.position: From the section headings, 'Candidates for Mayor' and 'Candidates for City Councillor'. All eight seats are one city-wide contest, so the title carries no district.
